notes.title: Update on July 20
notes.notes:
Update on July 20,
The overall new rendering scheme is upgraded, and the overall picture effect is more delicate and realistic.
Integrating the real-looking DLC into the game itself, now there is no need to install the real-looking DLC separately, you can directly select the character style in the main interface of the game.
Model penetration repair of clothing.
Bug fixes, fixed a bug that caused data errors when entering the game before reading the steam achievements.
The card drop has been submitted for review, and there is a chance to get a new steam card during the game.

notes.title: Update August 28, 2020
notes.notes:
Fix some bugs:
1. Adjusted the skill damage balance of some characters.
2. Modified the problem of wearing molds for most garments.
3. The rendering order of transparent clothing has been modified. Multi-layer transparent clothing can now be rendered correctly.

notes.title: Update May 18, 2020
notes.notes:
Fix some bugs:
1. Remove the debug information from the Z key on the keyboard.
2. The startup bug caused by different cloud archiving issues now adds the step of detecting the necessary files.
3. The initial 10 characters in the game can now be customized to modify the shape.
4. At the same time, in the game manual, the character display page has added the function of restoring the character's appearance.
